gasTracker.faqQ1: What does gas refer to on the blockchain?
gasTracker.faqA1: Gas is the amount of native tokens required to perform a transaction on the blockchain.
gasTracker.faqQ2: How can I check {{ chain }} gas fees?
gasTracker.faqA2: You can easily check live {{ chain }} gas fees on Blockscout by visiting our gas tracker. It displays current gas fees in {{ gwei }} for all {{ chain }} transactions.
gasTracker.faqQ3: What is the average gas fee for {{ chain }} transactions?
gasTracker.faqA3: The average gas fee for {{ chain }} transactions depends on network congestion and transaction complexity. Blockscout provides real-time gas fee estimations to help users make informed decisions.
gasTracker.faqQ4: How does Blockscout calculate gas fees?
gasTracker.faqA4: Blockscout calculates gas fees based on the average price of gas fees spent for the last 200 blocks.
